name: transit-app-shred

brief.objective: Shred RFP-2026-14 from the Harbor Point Regional Transit District and prepare a bid/no-bid brief for Lumen Fieldworks.

notes: Workspace fixture: evals/fixtures/transit-app. Expect 23+ requirements with R-013 (10-page Technical Volume) and R-014 (3-page Price Volume) typed format, R-022 (Form P-1) typed form, R-023 evaluation; 'Letters of support are not required' and 'The District will post answers' must NOT be requirements.
